title: Easier updates, clearer calls and meetings

items.text: A short popup now tells you when a new version of MatterChat is ready, with Update now or Remind me later.
A call in progress now sits at the top of the conversation, next to the call buttons.
Meetings show a live transcript, captions keep to the languages you choose, and notes come from what was said.
Draw and point on a shared screen, and make it full screen in the desktop app.
The desktop app uses your computer's own close, minimise and full screen buttons.
